approaches_tried.approach: Reuse candidate 954 both as the isolated ordinary-candidate baseline AND as one half of the in-batch-direction pair (954+959, identical file_scope)
approaches_tried.reason: orchestrate-batch-admit.sh always compares a candidate against every non-terminal task in the WHOLE state file, not just CLI args, so giving 959 the same file_scope as 954 made 954 incidentally collide with 959 in every other assertion that used 954 alone. Fixed by adding a dedicated, fully-isolated candidate 960 for the ordinary-candidate baseline, keeping 954+959 exclusively for the in-batch-direction pairing test.
